description: NYC child and dependent care credit (IT-216-I Worksheet 2, 2025), declining-factor region: single, wages $26,500 -> FAGI $26,500. Factor row index = ceil((26,500 - 25,000) / 200) = ceil(7.5) = 8 -> line 6 factor = 0.765 - 0.030 x 8 = 0.525 (printed table row $26,400-26,600 -> 0.525). NYS credit $1,000; under-4 expenses $3,000 of $6,000 total -> ratio 0.5000. Line 5 = mulDiv(100000 x 300000 / 600000) = 50,000c ($500.00). Line 7 = mulDiv(50,000 x 525 / 1000) = 26,250c ($262.50) -> roundToDollar half-up -> $263.00 (26300c).
